content:
taylor-finance: FYI — noticed a ~12,300 USD GPU run from the notebook reservations pool last night that came through untagged. Shows as rn-87321 and rn-87322, ~14h each. Need a short-term mitigation so this doesn't repeat.

kai-ops: Ack. Can you paste the run ids + any autoscaler logs? I'll correlate with node lifecycle events.

taylor-finance: Run ids: rn-87321, rn-87322. billing-bot mark shows owner=null. Total cost 12300.24 USD.

billing-bot: auto: detected untagged GPU consumption: 12300.24 USD; affected resources: rn-87321,rn-87322; suggested action: alert on create when owner tag missing.

sam-dev: Those are from the interactive notebook reservation service — we spin ephemeral reserved GPUs for users. We currently don't require an owner tag in the create flow. I can add enforcement but need ops + product ok.

taylor-finance: Proposal: 1) enable dry-run alerts for notebook creations missing an 'owner' tag (48h), 2) set a temporary budget warning on the notebook pool at 1,000 USD/day, 3) plan enforcement (block or auto-inject) after a 1-week dry-run.

kai-ops: Fine with dry-run alerts. For enforcement, sidecar injection makes sense (either inject owner from user context or block). Sidecar PR ~1 week to review + staging.

sam-dev: I'll prototype a sidecar that either injects owner metadata or returns 400 on missing owner. Quick alert config I propose (dry-run):
```
alert: NotebookNoOwner
expr: count(gpu_start{owner=\"\"}) > 0
for: 5m
notify: #infra-alerts, finance@redwood.com
mode: dry-run
```

lucy-legal: If we decide to block launches, we need an exception flow and audit trail. Research projects sometimes use shared accounts and tagging isn't always present — legal wants a clear appeals path.

taylor-finance: Agreed. Dry-run today, enforcement after we have exceptions and audit. Also running a retro fit: reconcile last 90 days of notebook runs and assign provisional owners where possible. I'll open a JIRA for the reconciliation and budget hold.

kai-ops: Creating infra ticket INFRA-4122 for sidecar + dry-run alert ownership. I'll attach autoscaler logs and set the alert to email finance ops. Keeping PD routing low for now.

billing-bot: auto: dry-run alert scheduled for NotebookNoOwner; link: https://alerts.internal/alert/NotebookNoOwner

sam-dev: :thumbsup: starting sidecar prototype, assigning to myself (sam-dev). ETA: demo in staging by end of next week.

taylor-finance: Thanks — finance will review allocation rules once prototype is live. I'll also coordinate comms to ML-platform and notify heavy users about the upcoming change.

lucy-legal: Please include the exception policy draft in the INFRA ticket before enforcement.

taylor-finance: Will do. Next steps: kai -> infra ticket + alert enabled (today), sam -> prototype sidecar, finance -> reconciliation JIRA. Follow-up sync Friday.
